title: Subject pair comparison
description: Derived per-pair ratios between subjects of one attempt, sealed as evidence alongside the run. Floats are allowed here because a comparison is evidence, never an identity: no identity document may contain a float. Written by crates/benchctl from the legacy result views and modeled in crates/bench-report; documentation mirror of the Comparison serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/classify.rs, which is the source of truth.

comparable.description: True only when every compared subject produced valid, semantically matched evidence. False leaves the ratios present but meaningless.

reasons.description: Why the subjects are not comparable; empty when comparable is true.

pairs.description: One entry per ordered subject pair.

baseline.description: Subject name in the denominator of every ratio.

candidate.description: Subject name in the numerator of every ratio.

goodput_ratio.description: candidate acknowledged_records_per_second over baseline. Null when either subject produced no result.

p99_ratio.description: candidate latency_ns.p99 over baseline. Null when either subject produced no result.
